hook: Ross Wightman worked in industry as a software and machine learning engineer before turning his attention to open-sourcing computer vision research. In 2019 he created timm, short for PyTorch Image Models, a library that reimplemented and made reproducible a wide range of state-of-the-art image classification architectures, complete with pretrained weights and training scripts. Working largely as an independent maintainer based in Vancouver, he steadily expanded timm to cover models spanning ResNet, EfficientNet, Vision Transformers and dozens of other architectures, and in 2021 co-authored the paper "ResNet strikes back: An improved training procedure in timm" documenting improved training recipes built into the library. Timm became a foundational dependency for computer vision research and production systems, and Hugging Face took on stewardship of the project, with Wightman continuing as its lead maintainer for several years before stepping back from that role in 2026.

achievements.title: Creator of timm (PyTorch Image Models)
